mentions.name: delta.md e-commerce site
mentions.description: This e-commerce storefront for the author's brother is built with Rails, with most of the code written by Claude (AI-assisted). Completed in a week, it has already brought in 4 orders, unlike the brother's old site which didn't really work.
mentions.problem: The brother's old e-commerce site didn't really work, so a new functioning storefront was needed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
vibecoded a e-commerce for my brother https://delta.md/

with rails and most of it written by claude - was a pretty fun project. done in a week - and brought 4 orders already, unlike old site that didnt really work.
